description: Wave 6D-10 strictly read-only console probes (45 probes across 4 batches) covering cells, worldspaces, encounter zones, spatial distance/pos/angle/heading/scale/refcount/enable/move/ref-walk queries; weather, climate, time/calendar globals, moon phase, sky color, and image spaces/modifiers; water traits/noise/effects/immersion, lights/flags/radius/spatial light amount, interior lighting templates, and sound/audio markers; and map markers, ShowMap/ShowAllMapMarkers, fast travel flags/encumbrance, regions, IsInList, near cells, and world GMSTs.
